prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Grid Layout for Path Selection Screen: Redesign the choose_path screen with a grid layout displaying clear visual path options to help users compare tracks quickly.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Experience", "body": "Select the path that best matches how you want to interact with your new companion."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Personality Selection Screen: Add a new screen called new_personality right after pick_friend where users select their pet's core temperament before proceeding.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_personality", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_personality": {"headline": "Give Your Pet a Personality", "body": "Choose whether your pet companion is playful, calm, or energetic.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Desktop Controls Overview on Finish Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen using a spotlight layout highlighting taskbar controls and basic desktop pet commands.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop", "body": "Access your pet anytime from the system tray icon to hide, summon, or chat.", "hint": "Right-click your desktop pet anytime for quick settings."}}
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Reassurance Hint: Display a hint on the sign_in screen explaining that signing in syncs pets and prevents data loss.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in to keep your pet safely backed up across sessions and avoid accidental profile resets."}}
4: [adoption, layout] Stage Layout for Adoption Certificate: Change the adoption_certificate screen layout to stage view for a prominent confirmation experience.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Confirm your companion's details before placing them on your desktop."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Status display on Waiting Screen: Show explicit status text and time estimate on the waiting screen while background assets render.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "headline": "Preparing Desktop Pet Environment", "body": "Rendering your pet and setting up desktop overlay tools. Please hold tight."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Welcome Story Value Proposition Copy: Update the story screen headline and body copy to emphasize quick set up and direct desktop companionship.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Create an interactive pet that lives right on your desktop in less than two minutes."}}
7: [finish, new_flow] Post-Onboarding Quick Start Checklist Flow: Insert a new screen called new_quick_start between waiting and home_intro formatted as a interactive checklist for basic pet shortcuts.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_quick_start", "home_intro"], "new_quick_start": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Desktop Quick Start Guide", "body": "Review key controls to manage your pet on your desktop seamlessly."}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Clarification Copy: Update the headline and body text on sign_in to clarify how credentials link to local desktop profiles.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Pet Profile", "body": "Connecting your account ensures your companion data and custom assets remain linked to your system."}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Notification Banner on Waiting Screen: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users know when background setup finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will send a desktop alert as soon as your pet companion is ready."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning choose_path with a grid layout and updated copy remains within onboarding guidelines.
Adding a personality selection screen during onboarding is permitted under rule 4.
Redesigning home_intro with a spotlight desktop controls layout is allowed as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Adding a sync reassurance hint to the sign-in screen is valid copy customization.
Updating the layout of the adoption certificate screen is allowed within onboarding design changes.
Displaying progress and a real time estimate on the waiting screen complies with fair design rules.
Updating story screen copy to introduce the desktop pet does not violate any base rules.
Inserting a quick start checklist screen into the onboarding sequence is permitted.
Clarifying sign-in data persistence copy is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Enabling ready notifications on the waiting screen is allowed within onboarding configurations.
